title: Close the remaining gaps in the per-action gates brief before it is built
outcome: Close the remaining gaps in the per-action gates brief before it is built
acceptance: docs/features/action-gates.md's operation inventory names four state-changing operations including action_reconcile, and its state list includes reported-unresolved and expired
the brief requires a fresh idempotency key for automatic reauthorization after an expired grant or a changed policy or map, and the Deadline acceptance case covers it
the brief settles the operator's route for a begun action with no report (operator decision as first report, or a host must first report unknown) and covers it in the Operator decision case
the brief states that a second complete with a different payload on a reported grant is refused (conflict or directive to action_reconcile), with an acceptance case
the brief states that action_status returns the grant id and its newest observation id and can be queried by grant and listed by run or project for unresolved actions
